item.title: 2XKO appears to leak its console and Season 1 release date... again
item.description: <p>2XKO has been in the hands of PC players for a few months already, and it seems now we know when console owners can get in on the action too.</p> <p>Riot Games appears to have accidentally posted a trailer early that leaked their own Season 1 release date.</p>

item.title: SNK reaffirms Season 2 plans for Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves in New Year's Eve message for fans
item.description: <p><a href='https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/nov/25/mr-big-trailer-ffcotw-launch/'>Mr. Big</a> was recently added to <a href='https://www.eventhubs.com/news/fatal-fury/'>Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves</a> as its final Season 1 challenger. Before him came Andy, Ken, Joe and Chun-Li.</p> <p>Prior to the release of the game, the developers <a href='https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2024/oct/03/season3-fatal-fury-cow-oda-character/'>promised at least three seasons of content</a> in the years ahead.

item.title: Capcom teases new Alex artwork for Street Fighter 6 in celebration of 2025's conclusion
item.description: <p>We're approaching the end of 2025. Of course, there are plenty of exciting fighting game announcements waiting for us in the year of 2026.</p> <p>For <a href='https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/'>Street Fighter 6</a>, Alex and Ingrid of <a href='https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/jun/06/street-fighter-season-3/'>Season 3</a> are set to be released early Spring and late Spring of next year respectively. item.title: Update: Katsuhiro Harada shares New Year's messages on the future as his time with Tekken and Bandai Namco is now over
item.description: <p><strong>Update:</strong> Katsuhiro Harada has now shared a post confirming his time with the Tekken series has come to an end after 31 years.</p> <p>After decades under the same leadership, Tekken is now entering a brand new era moving into 2026.</p> <p>It appears that longtime Tekken Director Katsuhiro Harada is officially gone from Bandai Namco.</p>

item.title: New Virtua Fighter Project Producer says he thinks 2026 will be the time to fully unveil the game in New Year's message
item.description: <p>It's now been over <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2024/dec/12/virtua-fighter-announcement/">one year since the New Virtua Fighter Project was first revealed to the world</a>, but we've learned very little about the long-awaited title since.</p> <p>That may finally be changing in the new year, however.</p>

item.title: Fighting game-themed Happy New Year artwork released by Capcom, Bandai Namco, Arc System Works, SNK, SEGA and French Bread
item.description: <p>After a long year of successes and hardships in 2025, we've finally entered the new year of 2026 and who knows what's waiting for us on the horizon?</p> <p>As a celebration for the new year that is now upon us, several of the biggest fighting game developers have released special artwork and graphics to wish all of their fans a happy new year which we've compiled in this story.</p>

item.title: New teaser trailer for fan-made Sega vs. Capcom fighting game shows first gameplay of Vyse from Skies of Arcadia and Morrigan

item.title: Will Bandai Namco reveal all of Tekken 8's third season characters at once or keep their identities hidden as they've previously done?
item.description: <p>We're just about one month away from the Tekken World Tour Finals which will be taking place in Malmö, Sweden.</p> <p>While there's no guarantee that we'll see any Season 3 news at the event, it would be a prime opportunity for Bandai Namco and the Tekken team to unveil what's coming next, but one of the more important questions for fans since last year isn't so much when they'll bring new reveals — but how?</p>

item.title: Street Fighter 6 Director and Producer promise more updates and collaborations for 2026 in New Year's message
item.description: <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/">Street Fighter 6</a> is trucking along in it's third year, but the game has been going through something of a content drought lately.</p> <p>The Street Fighter Director and Producer promise there is more to come for players here in 2026.</p>
